shared_request: Diagnose the reported failure in this local bundle. Read README.md and use safe local source inspection and commands to distinguish plausible causes. This is diagnosis only: do not edit files or apply fixes. Give the supported conclusion, concrete observations, remaining uncertainty and a narrow next step where needed. Do not use network access.

assembly: Each subject sees shared_request followed by exactly its case request and its copied subject directory. The evaluator sees no rubric, oracle, other cases or comparative outcomes. Condition instructions differ only by target skill supply; record actual capability/tool context.
